invented.quote: Our fresh food is limited by transportation, not supply.
invented.why: The brief says the food bank had to turn down produce because it had no way to pick it up cold or store it, not because of transportation alone.

invented.quote: cold transport is what stands between our clients and fresh food that is already available in our community.
invented.why: The brief states that both a lack of cold pickup and a lack of storage caused the food bank to turn down the produce, not cold transport alone.

invented.quote: The van will let us collect produce directly from farms and keep it cold until distribution.
invented.why: The brief does not state that the van will be used to store or keep food cold until distribution, especially given that a lack of storage was a separate reason for turning food down.

invented.quote: In the first year, our goal is to accept the farm produce we currently turn away: at least 9,000 additional pounds of fresh food.
invented.why: The brief states that the goal for the narrative is to double the amount of fresh food handed out in the first year (an increase of 72,000 pounds), not a goal of at least 9,000 additional pounds.

invented.quote: we will put every reporting deadline on our board calendar at the time of award and assign one named volunteer to prepare each report, with a board member responsible for submitting it on time.
invented.why: The brief does not mention a board of directors, a board calendar, or this specific plan for managing future grant reports.

invented.quote: Much of the fresh food our neighbors need is grown a few miles away.
invented.why: The brief mentions 'local farms' but does not state how many miles away they are or that they grow much of the fresh food the neighbors need.

invented.quote: With the Foundation's help and our own reserves, we can start saying yes next summer.
invented.why: The brief does not specify when the grant or the van will be awarded or that the project will start next summer.
